subject: CareHub MAP: hosting mode & region questions (decision checklist)
messages:
From: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@carehub.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal - CareHub <legal@carehub.ai>
Date: 2027-02-24T15:12:00Z
Subject: CareHub MAP: hosting mode & region questions

Hi Michael / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the execs liked the latency and routing controls. We pulled together an initial MAP and a short list of constraints for our internal review (attached: carehub_map_v1.xlsx). A couple of quick clarifications before we finalize the plan:

- We need to know whether we should plan for Hosted for the PoC or if Dedicated capacity is required from day one given our PHI-like workflows.
- If we go Hosted initially, can you guarantee EU-only data residency for inference?
- What are the expected lead times and SLA differences between Hosted, Dedicated, and Private for EU region?

We're aiming for a commercial close by the end of Q1 and a PoC kickoff in mid-March. Legal is on copy for any data residency language.

Best,
Sasha Patel
Head of Product
CareHub.ai

Attachment: carehub_map_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-25T09:08:00Z
Subject: Re: CareHub MAP: hosting mode & region questions

Team — forwarding CareHub's note. Key asks: EU-only residency, guidance on mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), and lead times. They want commercial close end of Q1 and PoC mid-March.

My read: CareHub's traffic profile in the PoC will be low QPS but high sensitivity. Recommend we propose: Hosted (EU region) for immediate PoC with contractual EU-residency for inference and a technically isolated Dedicated path as the committed production target. Private (on-prem/VPC) should be scoped as an uplift option for regulated data if their legal team insists.

Immediate asks for you both:
- Marissa: can you update the MAP and pricing worksheet with a Hosted-EU PoC row + Dedicated-reserve pricing and an option for Private onboarding costs? (I added the HubSpot link below.)
- Karthik: timeline and lead times for Dedicated capacity in eu-west; any constraints on provisioning or contract terms we should flag?
- Laura: CS readiness for a mid-March PoC (runbook + gating criteria) and what we'll need from CareHub to validate latency and KV cache behaviour.

I'll coordinate with legal on residency language but want the commercial picture first.

- Michael
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-26T11:45:00Z
Subject: Re: CareHub MAP: hosting mode & region questions (updated MAP & pricing)

Attached is an updated MAP and pricing worksheet (carehub_map_v2.xlsx) that shows:

- PoC path: Hosted (eu-west) with contractual data residency + 30-day PoC pricing credit.
- Production target: Dedicated pool (reserved vGPU capacity) with SLA bump and IP isolation.
- Optional: Private deployment estimate (on-prem/VPC) as an add-on with longer lead time and separate licensing.

Notes and asks:
- I've included a short 'must-have' column for legal (SOC2 controls, data retention, key management). Please confirm we can provide SOC2 summary and the standard SOC2 statement to CareHub (I attached a placeholder).
- Commercial ask: confirm a firm provisioning SLA for Dedicated in eu-west (lead time). Also, we should propose a mutual action plan milestone: PoC kickoff by 2027-03-15, decision point (go/no-go) 2027-04-01, production cutover target 2027-05-15.

I'll push this into the hubspot deal (see link). If legal wants more, I'll loop them in.

Thanks,
Marissa
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: carehub_map_v2.xlsx, POC_requirements.docx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-28T08:32:00Z
Subject: Re: CareHub MAP: hosting mode & region questions (timeline & provisioning)

Quick timeline and constraints from infra/ops:

- Hosted (eu-west): immediate — we can pin their traffic to eu-west and enforce data egress controls in the control plane. No hardware lead time.
- Dedicated (eu-west reserved pool): lead time for capacity reservation and scheduling is typically 6-8 weeks from signed commitment for dedicated GPU pools in eu-west. We can offer a fast-track 4-week window with an up-front non-refundable deposit (recommended for Q1 close).
- Private (on-prem/VPC): requires scoping, KMS integration, and at least a 12-week delivery runway; this is a separate SOW.

Recommendation: propose Hosted-EU for PoC and include a Dedicated-reserve term to kick in at the production decision (we can schedule Dedicated provisioning contingent on contract signature + deposit). That aligns to the MAP dates Marissa suggested.

Action items for sales pack:
- Marissa: add the 4-week fast-track option with deposit line to the pricing sheet.
- Michael: confirm acceptable deposit terms (refundable conditions).
- Laura: align CS runbook to the 3-week prep window before PoC kickoff for environment validation.

- Karthik
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@carehub.ai>
Date: 2027-03-01T10:22:00Z
Subject: Re: CareHub MAP: hosting mode & region questions (CS runbook + next steps)

Sasha / team — looping in CS readiness and next steps.

Summary of what CS will do for the PoC (Hosted-eu):
- Week -3 to -1 (pre-kickoff): environment access, test dataset ingest, and latency baseline checks. We'll need a short sample of anonymized traffic and the PoC success criteria documented (throughput, median latency < 120ms, prefix cache hit target).
- PoC (Week 0): run scripted load tests and three production-like scenarios (cold-start, burst, KV-heavy). We'll capture token-level cost and latency breakdowns in the Console dashboard.
- Decision window (Day +14): run eval prompts and quality checks. We'll produce a pass/fail summary tied to the MAP criteria.

Dependencies / asks from CareHub:
- Access to a sandbox dataset (anonymized), account admin for provisioning, and confirmation that PHI-like content will be synthetic for PoC.
- Legal: confirmation on the residency clause (we can mirror in contract: inference processing confined to eu-west and no replication out of EU).

I'll assemble a CS runbook draft and share by Friday. If marketing needs to show a demo during PoC, let me know and we'll reserve an hour for a joint session.

Next steps (internal):
- Marissa to send updated pricing with deposit/fast-track line (action: Marissa, by EOD Tue).
- Karthik to confirm final lead-time wording for contract (action: Karthik, by EOD Tue).
- Michael to coordinate with Legal for residency clause and prepare the draft addendum.

Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOC2_summary.pdf
